positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
NOCTEM is an interactive and adaptive telemedicine platform that combines the high-quality care of sleep clinics and cost-efficiency of digital technologies.

With NOCTEM, healthcare providers can reclaim dollars spent on sleep aids and gadgets with no or limited benefits, and provide evidence-based, personalized sleep recommendations.

positions.title: Director Of Technology
positions.description:
• Created “lite” version of Waters Center’s TTS application using VueJS
and Nuxt.
• Created Dockerfile, build, and deployment scripts for the VueJS
application. Docker container and web app both configured on Azure.
• Created custom events platform allowing TTS users to register for
virtual events through the platform. Each registration is then saved
along with event and user record in Salesforce.

positions.title: Technology and Operations Coordinator
positions.description:
• Redesigned and built company website
• Build front and back end of the Waters Center’s flagship technology
product the Thinking Tools Studio (TTS). Front end of the application
is built using ReactJS and the backend uses Node, Express, and
MySQL.
• Implemented Waters Center Salesforce buildout
• Connected the backend of TTS to workflows in Salesforce and other
apps using Zapier webhooks.

positions.title: Technical Consultant
positions.description:
Handled various technical responsibilities including web and mobile development
for new projects. Also provided hardware support and added additional
features to existing applications.

positions.title: Academy Pittsburgh - Full Stack Web Developer(Student)
positions.description:
@AcademyPGH provides condensed and practical technology skill building that fills gaps in our region’s freelance, business, startup, and nonprofit talent pools. Sessions are created to service the objectives of partner organizations including, but not limited to, creating a more impactful and inclusive technology ecosystem.

As an APGH graduate I have learned and gained real world experience in Ruby, C#, Javascript, React, MVC, Entity Framwork, Rails, and HTML/CSS through project-based learning and a rigorous curriculum.

positions.title: Director of Operations
positions.description: After the initial success in my previous role my responsibilities grew to include the day-to-day operations of the company as well as managing web, software, and graphic design projects for our clients. Acted as scrum master and project owner throughout project lifecycle. Delivered 100s of successful projects and worked with clients to manage integration of new software into business workflow.  Nurtured company revenue growth to .5 million in 2015 and 2016.

positions.title: Business Development Manager
positions.description: Established the company with my friend and business partner in late 2011.  Built and managed sales and marketing efforts from company ground-up.  Created and nurtured relationships with new and potential clients. Generated $28,000 in gross revenue for the company the first 4 months of 2011 and $160,000 in 2012.
